about: Examples of the instructions and accounts of programs/pinocchio-escrow that the Anchor IDL does not describe. Generated and checked by equivalence/tests/interface_vectors.rs; see the program README for the interface.

budget_layout.budget: 349 bytes: discriminator sha256("account:Budget")[..8] (0), payer (8), spender (40), judge (72), mint (104, zero for SOL), nonce (136), created_slot u64 (152), open_slots (160), dispute_slots (168), judge_slots (176), total (184), unreserved (192), per_provider_cap (200), allowlist [address;4] (208), closed_slot (336), reservations u8 (344), unsettled u8 (345), flags u8 (346: 0x01 spender may waive, 0x02 closed), bump (347), vault_bump (348)
budget_layout.reservation: 147 bytes: discriminator sha256("account:Reservation")[..8] (0), budget (8), budget_created_slot u64 (40), payee (48), payout_account (80), reserved u64 (112), final_amount u64 (120), posted_slot u64 (128), disputed_slot u64 (136), state u8 (144: 0 open, 1 posted, 2 disputed, 3 paid), waived u8 (145), bump (146)

commitment.preimage: rating address (32) || opened_slot (u64 LE, 8) || signer address (32) || score (1) || salt (32)

delivery_exits: Every exit of a delivery-checked escrow (release, settle, cancel; SOL and token) takes the delivery account after its usual accounts and after the rating account if the escrow is rated. Its data is unchanged: an unrated escrow's exit names the lock slot, a rated one names the rating's opened slot, which is the same slot.

instructions.name: open_rating
instructions.note: data: judge address (all zero for none)

instructions.name: settle_escrow
instructions.note: rated SOL escrow: the rating account follows the five usual accounts; data: actual u64, then the slot the job's rating was opened in (u64 LE)

instructions.name: commit_rating
instructions.note: data: commitment = sha256(rating address, opened slot (u64 LE), signer address, score byte, 32-byte salt), then the slot the job's rating was opened in (u64 LE)

instructions.name: attest_quality
instructions.note: data: five scores, 1 to 10, then the slot the rating was opened in (u64 LE)

instructions.name: reveal_rating
instructions.note: data: score byte, 32-byte salt

instructions.name: confirm_attestation
instructions.note: data: the slot the job's rating was opened in (u64 LE), which the attestation stores

instructions.name: close_rating
instructions.note: no data

instructions.name: accept_rating
instructions.note: data: the slot the rating was opened in (u64 LE); lets a release by the payer open the rating

instructions.name: release_escrow
instructions.note: rated SOL escrow: the rating account follows the five usual accounts; data: the slot the job's rating was opened in (u64 LE)

instructions.name: dispute_attestation
instructions.note: data: the slot the job's rating was opened in (u64 LE), which the attestation stores

instructions.name: close_attestation
instructions.note: no data; resolved, or unresolved for longer than the resolution window

instructions.name: expire_rating
instructions.note: no data; the signer is anyone

instructions.name: cancel_escrow
instructions.note: rated SOL escrow: the rating account follows the four usual accounts and is closed; data: the slot the job's rating was opened in (u64 LE)

instructions.name: release_token_escrow
instructions.note: rated token escrow: the rating account follows the nine usual accounts; data: the slot the job's rating was opened in (u64 LE)

instructions.name: settle_token_escrow
instructions.note: rated token escrow: the rating account follows the nine usual accounts; data: actual u64, then the slot the job's rating was opened in (u64 LE)

instructions.name: cancel_token_escrow
instructions.note: rated token escrow: the rating account follows the seven usual accounts and is closed; data: the slot the job's rating was opened in (u64 LE)

instructions.name: open_delivery
instructions.note: in the lock slot only; data: judge address, verify_window_slots u64 (150 to 1512000), resolve_window_slots u64 (1500 to 3024000); judge_agent is the judge's registry record

instructions.name: record_delivery
instructions.note: by the payee, after the lock slot and before the escrow's refund window opens; data: opened_slot u64 (the escrow's lock slot), units u64, bytes u64, sha256 [32]

instructions.name: accept_delivery
instructions.note: by the payer, on a delivered job; data: opened_slot u64. The payee may then settle or claim at once

instructions.name: dispute_delivery
instructions.note: by the payer, on a delivered job, before the verify window ends; data: opened_slot u64

instructions.name: resolve_delivery
instructions.note: by the judge of a disputed SOL escrow, before its window ends; the rating account (if rated) then the delivery account follow the judge; data: payout u64 (to the payee before the fee, at most the locked amount), opened_slot u64

instructions.name: resolve_token_delivery
instructions.note: by the judge of a disputed token escrow; destination is the recipient recorded at lock; the rating account (if rated) then the delivery account follow the nine usual accounts; data: payout u64, opened_slot u64

instructions.name: open_budget
instructions.note: data: nonce [u8;16], spender, judge (all zero for none), open_slots u64, dispute_slots u64, judge_slots u64, total u64, per_provider_cap u64 (0 for the total), flags u8 (0x01 spender may waive), allowlist [address;4] (all-zero entries empty); the judge's agent record follows only when a judge is named

instructions.name: reserve
instructions.note: signed by the payee (pays the reservation's rent) and the spender; a SOL payout account is the payee itself; data: created_slot u64, amount u64 (the reservation's new total)

instructions.name: post_final
instructions.note: by the payee; at most the reservation, and a re-post may only lower it; data: created_slot u64, amount u64

instructions.name: waive
instructions.note: by the payer, or the spender when the budget has flag 0x01; data: created_slot u64

instructions.name: payout_budget
instructions.note: by anyone; also closes a paid reservation once its budget is closed or gone; data: created_slot u64

instructions.name: dispute
instructions.note: by the payer, on a budget with a judge, before the reservation's dispute window ends; data: created_slot u64

instructions.name: close_budget
instructions.note: by the payer or the spender, or anyone after the open period; refunds what is unreserved; data: created_slot u64

instructions.name: resolve_budget
instructions.note: by the judge, inside its window; data: created_slot u64, payout u64 (at most the posted amount)

instructions.name: open_token_budget
instructions.note: data: as open_budget; the vault is ["budget-vault", budget], a token account owned by the budget

instructions.name: set_payout_account
instructions.note: by the payee, before its reservation is disputed or paid; a token account of the budget's mint it owns (SOL: the payee itself); data: created_slot u64

instructions.name: close_token_budget
instructions.note: as close_budget; refund is a token account the payer owns; the SPL Memo program may follow; data: created_slot u64

instructions.name: payout_token_budget
instructions.note: by anyone; pays the recorded payout account, the treasury's token account and the payer's refund account; the SPL Memo program may follow; data: created_slot u64

instructions.name: resolve_token_budget
instructions.note: by the judge; accounts as payout_token_budget then the judge, then optionally the SPL Memo program; data: created_slot u64, payout u64
